summary: Create a valid customer support request
acceptance: Valid name and message create an Open request; invalid data shows a clear error.
Names use 2 to 80 trimmed characters; messages use 10 to 1000 trimmed characters.
Requests survive refresh in one browser; filters match status; close retains request details.
Keyboard users can expand and collapse help answers.

summary: Test and build the website automatically
acceptance: Tests and build execute on pull requests; a failure stops delivery.
A reviewed passing change on main deploys to a reachable GitHub Pages URL.
